name: explorer-expedition
description: Explorer Expedition Platform — API-first real-world game engine.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @explorer/shared-types && npm run build -w @explorer/engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @explorer/api && npm run build -w @explorer/creator-web && npm run build -w @explorer/studio && npm run build -w @explorer/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo
